# PACT

> Transactional safety for consequential AI-agent actions: bind an exact plan to canonical state, authenticate approval, issue one-shot commit authority, commit idempotently, verify authoritative state and emit durable receipt evidence.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/dharan1007/pact
Live product: https://pact-webmcp.vercel.app/
Canonical authority endpoint: https://pact-webmcp.vercel.app/api/pact

## Start here

- README: https://github.com/dharan1007/pact/blob/main/README.md

## Core facts

- Transaction operations: inspect, preview, approve, commit, verify, receipt.
- Approval: authenticated and bound to transaction/plan/base-version/identity claims.
- Commit authority: short-lived and single use.
- Commit retry identity: explicit idempotency key.
- Canonical state: atomic version CAS / exact replay semantics.
- Recovery: reconciles an uncertain post-write crash only against the exact authorized transaction.
- Deployment: Vercel Function + Redis-compatible HTTPS REST store in the reference runtime.
- Browser agent integration: experimental WebMCP producer API when supported.
- Remote MCP Registry: not currently claimed; do not invent an MCP endpoint that bypasses PACT authority.
- License: MIT.

## Verification

`npm run verify`

## Boundary

PACT proves the checked-in reference transaction behavior. It does not certify arbitrary downstream adapters, identity systems, Redis deployments or business authorization policies.
